svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 4-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 29.9 s, bun check 90.6 s, tsgo 122.4 s. Peak memory: tsrs 14.6 GiB, bun check 14.2 GiB, tsgo 36.7 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 3.90 s, 1.94 GiB; bun check 7.66 s, 1.41 GiB; tsgo 11.82 s, 5.61 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.39 s, 0.35 GiB; bun check 0.65 s, 0.23 GiB; tsgo 1.25 s, 0.58 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.69 s, 0.51 GiB; bun check 1.14 s, 0.31 GiB; tsgo 2.41 s, 0.86 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 2.96 s, 1.17 GiB; bun check 24.36 s, 5.18 GiB; tsgo 14.28 s, 3.63 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.15 s, 0.15 GiB; bun check 0.33 s, 0.10 GiB; tsgo 0.41 s, 0.14 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.23 s, 0.16 GiB; bun check 0.64 s, 0.11 GiB; tsgo 0.75 s, 0.16 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 2.82 s, 1.27 GiB; bun check 7.87 s, 0.84 GiB; tsgo 10.51 s, 3.17 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 3.27 s, 1.60 GiB; bun check 6.97 s, 1.26 GiB; tsgo 12.22 s, 4.42 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 3.36 s, 1.32 GiB; bun check 8.64 s, 0.82 GiB; tsgo 13.32 s, 3.32 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 4.12 s, 1.29 GiB; bun check 9.17 s, 0.95 GiB; tsgo 22.20 s, 4.49 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 4.06 s, 1.54 GiB; bun check 15.07 s, 0.69 GiB; tsgo 18.31 s, 3.94 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 0.91 s, 0.66 GiB; bun check 1.79 s, 0.45 GiB; tsgo 3.86 s, 1.33 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.85 s, 0.51 GiB; bun check 1.79 s, 0.35 GiB; tsgo 2.89 s, 1.01 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.42 s, 0.52 GiB; bun check 0.78 s, 0.39 GiB; tsgo 1.59 s, 0.97 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.73 s, 0.49 GiB; bun check 1.61 s, 0.34 GiB; tsgo 2.64 s, 0.93 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.45 s, 0.46 GiB; bun check 0.87 s, 0.31 GiB; tsgo 1.61 s, 0.80 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.58 s, 0.63 GiB; bun check 1.30 s, 0.45 GiB; tsgo 2.32 s, 1.31 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest (4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9V45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-18 13:03 UTC; tsrs commit 5a63a85f00cfae90ce075e1e9a6a235ef5e126a5. TypeScript 7.1.0-dev.20261018.1; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
